name: Save & load slots
oneLiner: A save/load screen with three slots (plus an autosave slot): each shows a tiny thumbnail point-sampled from the game's own screen at native resolution, the place, level and play time the game supplies. Save, load and delete with confirm; a version number with a migrate hook; a checksum, so a corrupted slot reads "Damaged data" instead of crashing; save codes to copy and paste. The game supplies serialize()/deserialize(); storage is a namespaced localStorage key with an in-memory fallback. Autoplay and ?t=&freeze=1 are untouched, and a load continues to the same end as an uninterrupted run.
notFor: games with no persistent progress (arcade score attack)
saving in the middle of an animation or cutscene that holds callbacks (the game must say canSave() false there)
cloud sync across devices (codes are a manual copy, not sync)

needs: serialize(): every variable the fixed step reads or writes (incl. RNG state and frame counter) as plain JSON data
deserialize(data): writes it back, rebuilding references from ids
where the screen opens (the `opens` parameter, named by the designer), in update logic
keys routed to the screen while busy() (key(code, down), press(), tap())
a fixed update step (update(stepMs)), also while busy, with the world paused
boot() once after setup, before the first step and any ?t= fast-forward
optional: summary() {place, level, time, note}, canSave(), migrate(), the canvas and thumbRect for thumbnails, the autoplay flag, autosave checkpoints
provides: busy flag: route keys here and pause the world while the slot screen is open
save/load/delete/export/import results via onAction and onDone (synchronous)
direct save(n) / load(n) / autosave() / selfTest() calls
panel rectangle, for other overlays to avoid

params.label: Where the slot screen opens (required; the designer's words)
params.default: the S key while exploring opens save / load; the L key on the title screen opens load

params.opens: the Escape key opens save / load; the title loads
touching a save crystal (save / load); the L key on the title (load)

assets: module/save-slots.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_SaveSlots): storage with fallback, envelope (version, checksum, summary, thumbnail), migration, the slot screen and its confirm dialogs, save codes, autoplay path, URL hooks, self-test
no image or audio files (thumbnails are taken from the game's own canvas)
